  • Constructor Details

    • SolidHelmholtzState

      public SolidHelmholtzState(double molarVolume, double helmholtzEnergy, double internalEnergy, double entropy, double enthalpy, double gibbsEnergy, double heatCapacityCp, double heatCapacityCv, double logFugacityCoefficient)
      Construct a solid thermodynamic state.
      Parameters:
      molarVolume - molar volume in m3/mol; must be positive
      helmholtzEnergy - molar Helmholtz energy in J/mol
      internalEnergy - molar internal energy in J/mol
      entropy - molar entropy in J/(mol K)
      enthalpy - molar enthalpy in J/mol
      gibbsEnergy - molar Gibbs energy or chemical potential in J/mol
      heatCapacityCp - molar constant-pressure heat capacity in J/(mol K)
      heatCapacityCv - molar constant-volume heat capacity in J/(mol K)
      logFugacityCoefficient - natural logarithm of the fugacity coefficient
